seo.title: Frequently Asked Questions
seo.description: Common questions about glide-out cabinet shelving: fit, cost, weight, warranty and installation.

sections.heading: Questions, answered.
sections.body: If yours is not here, call the shop. Nobody is working from a script.

items.question: Do you have to replace my cabinets?
items.answer: No. The shelves fit inside the cabinet boxes you already have. Your doors, drawer fronts, counters and plumbing all stay where they are.

items.question: Will they fit an older or non-standard cabinet?
items.answer: Usually yes, and that is the point of measuring on site. Older cabinets are rarely square, so each shelf is cut for one specific opening.

items.question: How much weight will a shelf hold?
items.answer: Our standard glides are rated to **100 lb** per shelf, which covers stand mixers, stacked cast iron and full cases of tinned goods.

items.question: How long does installation take?
items.answer: Most kitchens are done in a single morning. Larger jobs across several rooms can run to a full day, and we tell you which before you book.

items.question: What does it cost?
items.answer: Pricing is per shelf and depends on the width and the glide. You get a fixed quote after the free consultation, before anything is built.

items.question: Do you offer financing?
items.answer: Yes, on jobs over a threshold. See the [financing page](/financing) for the current terms.

items.question: What is the warranty?
items.answer: Lifetime on the glide hardware for as long as you own the home. Shelves themselves carry a five year warranty against defects.

items.question: Do I need to be home for the install?
items.answer: Someone over eighteen needs to be there to let the installer in and confirm the finished work.

sections.heading: Book a free measure.
sections.body: An hour on site, a fixed quote, no pressure to book on the day.
